title: Assessment Feedback
description:
Stage 9 artifact for the technical_assessment path (FR-023, AI §9.1). Rendered from the Stage 6 architecture and its trade-off reasoning.

AT LEAST ONE REJECTED APPROACH IS MANDATORY. FR-023: 'At least one rejected alternative approach is named with the reason for rejection.' minItems 1 is that requirement, expressed where it can be checked. A solution presented without alternatives cannot be defended under questioning, which is what this artifact is for — FR-023 is explicit that the output is 'structured for the user to understand and defend, not to submit verbatim'.

TRADE-OFFS ARE EQUALLY MANDATORY. An approach that costs nothing is either trivial or misdescribed.

rejected_approaches.description: FR-023 requires at least one, named with its reason.
